description: LAD 2017-18 signing period: 50 candidate international amateur signings discovered on the MLB transaction wire (bonuses unknown).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: Discovered from the MLB transaction wire by a documented rule; no complete published class list consulted yet; bonuses unknown; 9 foreign-born signees outside the rule not imported.
